summary: Robin Energy Ltd. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an Exhibit 99.1 press release with its financial results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. Q2 total vessel revenues were $2.6 million, net income $5.6 million or $11.01 per basic share, and cash $35.7 million versus $5.6 million at December 31, 2025; six-month net income was $6.1 million. Results include a completed $3.0 million issuer tender for 66,667 shares at $3.00 and a $12.8 million sale of the M/T Wonder Mimosa producing a $6.2 million gain. No new special-situation event or deal terms were announced.
